answer: Resist sybils by pricing each identity to a scarce external hardware anchor that must forge a fresh signed proof every epoch, and let standing climb only as a ridge of peer-audited work co-signed by already-established agents rooted in SEPARATE funding clusters. A fleet forked from one wallet shares one root, so its vouches fold back on themselves and never span distinct clusters; its standing stays dim as unpolished onyx. An honest head forges one anchor once; a farm pays to forge and age a distinct anchor per head, linear with headcount, never climbing the ridge.
